items.name: ChatGPT Images 2.6
items.tagline: Create, edit, and animate images with AI
items.description: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, more precise editing, and native GIF creation to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Create looping animations, maintain character and product consistency across edits, export SVGs, and control generation complexity.

items.name: Exa Monitors v2
items.tagline: Web search on a schedule that calls your agent, $2/1k runs
items.description: Exa Monitors v2 is web search on a schedule for AI agents. Describe what to watch, pick an interval, and Exa calls your webhook only when something new and relevant turns up, with a summary or JSON output and citations. Per Exa, v2 remembers what it has already sent, is quieter than v1, and costs $2 per 1k runs, down from $15. Watch prices, news, competitors, people and more. Python SDK and API available.

items.name: LiveReview
items.tagline: Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes
items.description: Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

items.name: Quest
items.tagline: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life
items.description: Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

items.name: GPT‑6 Cyber
items.tagline: OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders
items.description: GPT-6 Cyber is OpenAI’s cybersecurity model, which per OpenAI pairs stronger security research with better alignment. It powered OpenAI’s Linux kernel research. Rated Critical in cybersecurity, it starts with a small group of vetted Daybreak Red customers, with identity checks, MFA and an application required. OpenAI says broader access is expected over the coming weeks. No public pricing yet.

items.name: Google Omni 1.2 Flash
items.tagline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15s AI video at $0.07 per second
items.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google DeepMind’s video generation and editing model, now generally available. Per Google, clips run up to 15 seconds, up from 10, and 720p costs $0.07 per second, 30% less than Omni 1.1. New: multi-turn editing without regenerating, steadier characters and styles, clearer lip-sync and smoother camera moves. Draft at 360p or 720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K. In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

items.name: Muse Realtime Avatar
items.tagline: Turn voice chats with Muse into live video calls
items.description: Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. Voice and video come from one speech stream, so lips, expressions, gestures and posture move with every word, and the reply starts in about 870 ms. Unlike talking-head avatars that only animate a face, it moves hands and full body too, and the character stays consistent from turn to turn. In Meta's live-call tests, raters preferred it 78% of the time over Runway Characters and 88% over HeyGen LiveAvatar.

items.name: seam
items.tagline: Turn your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island
items.description: Seam turns the notch into a Dynamic Island. Dictate into any app, control music, see when Claude Code finishes and run a focus timer. Voice runs on your Mac. $19.90 once for 2 Macs, with a 48-hour free trial and no card.

items.name: Rex (Beta)
items.tagline: Building the multiplexer for all work
items.description: Hello, world. We've been building a terminal multiplexer and we think you're going to love it. Native apps (e.g., macOS/iOS), accessible from the web, multiplayer. From the creators of Ghostty and Echo.

items.name: Fleeep
items.tagline: The notes app for people who make things.
items.description: Fleeep is one calm place for everything that inspires you Most of us keep ideas in five places at once: screenshots, a notes app, saved posts, bookmarks and open tabs. Fleeep puts them in one place that works on your phone and your computer, online or off.

items.name: The Writer's Quarter
items.tagline: AI-Free Writing & Novel Planning Software
items.description: Write your manuscript, build your characters and keep every part of your story connected in one calm, visual, AI-free workspace.

items.name: Instagram Edits for Desktop
items.tagline: Instagram's free desktop video editor with AI agents
items.description: Instagram Edits is now on Mac, bringing professional video editing and AI agents together. Connect compatible AI assistants through MCP to assemble rough cuts and make edits, then take over with a multi-track timeline, keyframes, color grading, and precise audio controls. Export watermark-free videos in 4K, use Instagram's music library, and publish directly to Instagram. Free to use, with no subscription required for the core editor.

items.name: ClarifierAI for Chrome
items.tagline: Use AI for writing & translating in your Chrome
items.description: Now on Chrome: ClarifierAI rewrites, fixes and translates only the text you select, in any text field. Improve, Polite, Shorten, Grammar and 119 languages, right where you type ⚡️

items.name: Sendoff
items.tagline: Say "send it." to automatically email your list
items.description: Sendoff emails your list (newsletters, launches, announcements) from Claude or Codex, self-hosted on your own Cloudflare and AWS accounts and sending through Amazon SES.

items.name: kayet
items.tagline: the minimalistic text editor for macOS
items.description: A quiet, distraction-free text editor for macOS.

items.name: Switchy
items.tagline: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar
items.description: Mac switches, deploy status, local servers, 2FA codes and Claude/Codex limits in one native menu bar panel. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Free for 7 days without an account or card, then $4.99 once for up to 3 Macs.

items.name: Deal Pilot
items.tagline: AI SDR that books meetings in Japan, the US & SE Asia
items.description: Deal Pilot finds and verifies decision-makers by country and role, writes personalized cold email in English, Japanese or Chinese, and follows up until there's a meeting. 6.0% reply rate across 644 A/B-tested emails.

items.name: Trace by Context.dev
items.tagline: Weekly web scraping API benchmark
items.description: Compare web scraping APIs on a fresh sample every Friday. Explore page access, latency percentiles, document quality, cost per page, and failure reasons, with confidence intervals and page-level data.

items.name: Capnot
items.tagline: Make Screen Demos Clear, Even on Mute
items.description: Capnot puts captions, annotations and pointer tools on top of any app on your Mac, so a screen demo still makes sense with the sound off. Type a subtitle, or a speech bubble that follows your cursor, or just talk and it captions you live. Draw arrows, boxes and numbered steps, blur anything secret, then spotlight or magnify the part that matters. Every tool is one hotkey away and works with any screen recorder or screen share. No editing afterwards, no subscription.

items.name: Sequence Tool
items.tagline: Edit with words: long recordings into polished stories
items.description: Sequence Tool is a native Mac app that turns long recordings into stories. Edit from text, prepare multiple angles, and export. It offers on-device transcription with optional CLI and MCP, designed to speed first-pass editing and surface key moments faster. Create what Matters.
